facts.text_zh: 接近目标高度最后2000ft且有邻近航空器时，合理控制升降率并持续监控冲突趋势；发生RA时严格执行现行程序。
facts.text_en: When within the final 2000ft approaching the target altitude with nearby aircraft, appropriately control the vertical rate and continuously monitor conflict trends; in the event of an RA, strictly follow current procedures.
facts.source_note: 用户明确确认上海浦东、上海虹桥两场航前准备长期保留此TCAS运行控制内容，不作为历史事件来源。
